summary: Frontend-only iteration 4 of Teologia Viva PWA. ALL upstream blockers from iteration 3 are now confirmed FIXED: (a) clever-task Edge Function CORS preflight returns HTTP 204 with proper headers — Bíblia → btn-explicar-ia → verse-explanation now renders a 1965-char Gemini-generated theological explanation in ~20s; (b) Supabase RLS for authenticated users now works end-to-end — profiles upsert at signup persists (current_streak=1, plano=trial, trial_inicio set, last_devo_date=today via RPC register_devo_read), anotacoes CRUD works (create 0→1 then delete 1→0), mural_oracoes vou-orar increments contagem_oracoes (0→1) and btn-publicar-pedido inserts new pedido (2→3); (c) anotacoes table exists with proper RLS; (d) seeded data verified: 6 eixos (eixo-pill-all + 7 pills total counting 'Todos'), 8 cursos, 36 verses João 3, 2 mural_oracoes pedidos, 7 devocionais. Auth, streak, devocional, academia listing, bíblia reader + Explicar IA, comunidade CRUD, anotações CRUD, perfil + logout — ALL PASS. HOWEVER, two seed/data issues block the Aula + Tutor IA flows entirely, plus three minor UX bugs.

critical.issue: All 3 seeded aulas have curso_id=NULL (verified via authenticated REST: [{id:35,titulo:'Introdução à Teologia',curso_id:null,...},{id:36,...,curso_id:null},{id:37,...,curso_id:null,is_premium:true}]). Curso.jsx queries aulas WHERE curso_id=:id, so EVERY one of the 8 cursos shows 0 aulas in the UI. Consequently the entire Aula page (aula-titulo, aula-leitura, aula-video, aula-texto-apoio), btn-tutor-ia → AI Tutor drawer → ai-tutor-send → ai-tutor-messages, btn-aula-concluir, AND the premium-lock branch (btn-upgrade for is_premium=true) are 100% UNTESTABLE through the UI. Fix: in Supabase, UPDATE aulas SET curso_id = <some valid cursos.id> WHERE curso_id IS NULL — ideally distribute the 3 aulas across 1–2 cursos so progress + premium lock can be exercised.

minor.issue: Today's devocional 'O Valor da Sabedoria' (Tiago 1:5) has versiculo_texto = '' (empty string). UI renders the open-quote glyph then nothing — see screenshot. Fix: populate versiculo_texto with the actual verse text in the seed.

Empty (returns []). Eventos /eventos with GPS prompt cannot show any event card; acceptable per the test brief, but seeding 1 approved event with lat/lng near a common test coord would let next agent verify the 20km radius filter.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening biblia-book-picker mounts the Sheet but neither pick-book-{id} nor pick-chapter-{n} elements are found in the DOM (querySelectorAll returns 0 for both). The picker UI may render the books with different test-ids, or the portal/Sheet content isn't reaching the document at 420×844. Book picker therefore cannot be exercised by automated tests; biblia-prev/biblia-next still work for navigation.

Carry-over from iter 3. The fixed #emergent-badge in the bottom-right intercepts pointer events on tab-comunidade/tab-eventos at 420×844. force=True clicks at the element center still don't navigate (URL stays). Reliable workaround used in tests: click at element top edge (y+5..8). End users on the same viewport will hit the same intercept. Fix: raise bottom-nav z-index above #emergent-badge, OR add bottom padding to the badge.

ui_bugs.component: Toast 'Conta criada — seu trial de 7 dias começou'
ui_bugs.issue: Toast overlays the top-right header-profile-btn for ~3–5s after signup, blocking the click that navigates to /perfil. UX: dismiss toast on outside-tap, or auto-dismiss in <2s, or render the toast below the header.

On hard reloads (page.goto), the AuthContext.loading spinner stays visible noticeably longer than a tab-click navigation; in test runs the loader was still showing after 5s for /perfil and /anotacoes. Cause appears to be supabase.auth.getSession() + profile fetch being awaited sequentially. Not a hard failure (waiting 8s+ resolves it) but feels janky on real devices.

integration_issues.flow: Aula page + AI Tutor (btn-tutor-ia → ai-tutor-input → ai-tutor-send → ai-tutor-messages) and Premium lock (btn-upgrade)
integration_issues.issue: Untestable end-to-end because no curso has any aula linked (see backend critical: aulas.curso_id IS NULL). The clever-task Edge Function itself is verified working via the Bíblia Explicar-IA flow, so once aulas are linked Tutor IA is expected to work without further code changes.

issues: The blockquote renders a stylized '\"\"' but no verse text because seed has versiculo_texto=''. Visually it shows two empty quotes which looks broken.
Right-most tabs (Comunidade, Eventos) collide with the Made-with-Emergent floating pill — users must tap left of the pill.

action_items: CRITICAL — In Supabase: UPDATE aulas SET curso_id = <existing cursos.id> WHERE curso_id IS NULL; distribute the 3 seeded aulas across at least 1 free curso (e.g., curso 1) so the Aula page + AI Tutor drawer + premium-lock (is_premium=true on aula 37) become reachable through the UI.

MEDIUM — Update today's devocional row: SET versiculo_texto = 'Se algum de vós tem falta de sabedoria, peça-a a Deus, que a todos dá liberalmente e nada lhes impropera, e ser-lhe-á dada.' (or equivalent for Tiago 1:5).

HIGH UX — Raise BottomNav z-index above #emergent-badge or pad-bottom the badge so tab-comunidade and tab-eventos are reliably tappable on 420px width. Currently force=True clicks at element center don't navigate.

MEDIUM — Investigate biblia-book-picker Sheet: pick-book-{id} and pick-chapter-{n} test-ids are not rendering. Verify books list is populated and the test-ids are emitted on the actual rendered list items.
LOW — Auto-dismiss the 'Conta criada' toast in <2s, or render it below the header so it doesn't block header-profile-btn.
LOW — Optionally seed 1 row in eventos_comunidade with status='approved' and a lat/lng near (-23.5505,-46.6333) to validate the GPS 20km radius filter.
critical_code_review_comments: src/pages/Curso.jsx silently returns empty list when no aulas — already shows 'Nenhuma aula publicada ainda', good defensive UX. But the curso-progress-pct uses (concluidas / aulas.length || 1) which is fine; consider hiding the progress bar entirely when aulas.length===0 to avoid confusing 0%.

src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx: loadProfile is awaited inside getSession's IIFE BEFORE setLoading(false). If supabase REST is slow (>2s), the App-level 'Teologia Viva…' loader shows for the full duration on hard refresh. Consider setLoading(false) immediately after setSession/setUser and let profile resolve in the background; pages already handle null profile via synthetic fallback.

src/pages/Anotacoes.jsx delete uses optimistic UI then awaits delete — works in tests but no visual confirmation step (e.g., AlertDialog) means an accidental tap on btn-excluir-anotacao-{id} permanently removes the row. Consider adding a confirm modal for destructive action.

src/lib/ai.js does not surface a toast on fetch failure of clever-task; today the function works, but if Gemini returns a 5xx the user sees nothing. Add toast.error('Falha ao consultar IA. Tente novamente.') in caller catch blocks (Aula AITutorDrawer + Biblia Explicar-IA).

Layout.jsx renders the header on every protected route; on small screens the toast (top-right) overlaps the header-profile-btn. Toast position should be 'top-center' or 'bottom-center' to avoid blocking the only navigation path to /perfil before the bottom nav loads.

Edge Function clever-task confirmed working with proper CORS (204 OPTIONS) and Gemini-flash-latest produced 1965-char PT-BR theological response in <25s during Bíblia Explicar-IA test — production-ready.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only request); Supabase RLS + Edge Function verified working in-browser
success_rate.frontend: 10 of 13 features pass end-to-end (~77%): Auth signup + plan-badge ✅, streak ✅, devocional render ✅ (versiculo empty data), academia listing ✅, bíblia reader + Explicar IA Gemini ✅, comunidade vou-orar + novo-pedido CRUD ✅, anotações CRUD ✅, perfil + logout ✅, RPC streak ✅. FAILS: Aula page entirely (aulas.curso_id=null), AI Tutor (depends on aula), premium lock (depends on aula). Bottom-nav UX intercept on Comunidade/Eventos tabs is a UX hiccup not a functional fail.

rca of the issue: Primary RCA (Aula flow blocked): Supabase aulas seed contains 3 rows (ids 35,36,37) all with curso_id=NULL. Verified by authenticated GET https://wuwmjovqdahlpfkncydg.supabase.co/rest/v1/aulas?select=id,titulo,curso_id,is_premium,ordem returning [{id:35,curso_id:null},{id:36,curso_id:null},{id:37,curso_id:null,is_premium:true}]. Curso.jsx query 'supabase.from(aulas).select(*).eq(curso_id, id)' yields [] for every cursos.id ∈ {1..8}. UI correctly renders 'Nenhuma aula publicada ainda'. Reproduction: signup → Academia → click any curso-card-* → see 0 aulas. Mitigation: SQL `UPDATE public.aulas SET curso_id = 1 WHERE id IN (35,36); UPDATE public.aulas SET curso_id = 1, is_premium = true WHERE id = 37;` (or pick a different curso). Secondary RCA (versiculo empty): devocionais row for today has versiculo_texto = '' — inserted but the verse text was missed in the seed. Mitigation: UPDATE devocionais SET versiculo_texto='...' WHERE referencia_biblica='Tiago 1:5'.
